hero.title: Care in every portion. More time together.
hero.lead: Gently cooked food for dogs and cats in convenient portioned pouches — delivered to your door in Georgia. Tell us about your pet in a couple of minutes — we'll help pick a menu and discuss a convenient subscription delivery schedule.
hero.imageAlt: A cat and a dog sitting next to each other

items: Portioned pouches that are easy to store and use

subscription.title: Subscription format
subscription.body: A supplement to your pet's usual food, or a full daily diet — choose the format that fits, with regular delivery.
subscription.body2: The exact cost depends on the menu and portion size you choose — take a short quiz and we'll put together an option for your pet and confirm the cost before you commit.

packaging.title: Packaging and storage
packaging.lead: Keep the food in the fridge or in a cool place, away from direct sunlight.
packaging.imageAlt: Illustration: an open fridge with portioned food pouches on the shelves

points.title: Fridge or a cool place
points.description: Store the pouches in the fridge or in a cool, dark place, away from sunlight and heat sources.

points.title: Doypack, like familiar pet food
points.description: The food is packed in portioned doypack pouches (stand-up pouches) — the same type of packaging used for classic wet pet food: it stands upright, opens easily and stores compactly.

points.title: Shelf life confirmed in advance
points.description: We'll confirm the exact storage timeframes together with the composition and delivery conditions.

items.quote: I liked that the food already comes pre-portioned: open the pouch, put it in the bowl — done. Very convenient for our everyday routine.
items.name: Nino

items.quote: Our cat is picky, so we started with a small amount. He ate the turkey eagerly. It's great that you can try different options and find what he likes.
items.name: Giorgi

items.quote: I used to cook for my dog separately, but after work I didn't always have the energy. With ready-made pouches, feeding became much easier. I especially appreciate not having to stand at the stove every evening.
items.name: Mariam

items.quote: Convenience is what matters most to me. The portion pouches are easy to store and take along on trips out of town with the dog. I also like the idea of regular delivery — less everyday hassle.
items.name: Levan

finalCta.title: Ready to talk about food for your pet?

dog-chicken.title: Chicken for dogs
dog-chicken.benefit: A mild, familiar taste most dogs already know — a good place to start with our food.
dog-chicken.alt: Chicken — the main ingredient of the dog food. Ingredient photo, not packaging.

dog-turkey.title: Turkey for dogs
dog-turkey.benefit: Light meat with a slightly stronger taste than chicken — an interesting way to add variety to the menu.
dog-turkey.alt: Turkey — the main ingredient of the dog food. Ingredient photo, not packaging.

dog-beef.title: Beef for dogs
dog-beef.benefit: A rich, hearty taste with a noticeable aroma — a hit with dogs that go for bolder flavors.
dog-beef.alt: Beef — the main ingredient of the dog food. Ingredient photo, not packaging.

cat-chicken.title: Chicken for cats
cat-chicken.benefit: A classic taste many cats already love — a safe choice to start exploring the menu.
cat-chicken.alt: Chicken — the main ingredient of the cat food. Ingredient photo, not packaging.

cat-turkey.title: Turkey for cats
cat-turkey.benefit: Light, tender meat with a mild taste — a nice alternative to chicken for variety.
cat-turkey.alt: Turkey — the main ingredient of the cat food. Ingredient photo, not packaging.

cat-fish.title: Fish for cats
cat-fish.benefit: A bold fish taste and aroma that cats find especially appealing — one of the most popular flavors in the lineup.
cat-fish.alt: Salmon — the main ingredient of the cat food. Ingredient photo, not packaging.

items.q: Which cities do you deliver to?
How much does the subscription cost?
items.a:
The estimated cost is 60 to 200 GEL per month, depending on the chosen menu and portion volume.

Take a short quiz — we will suggest an option for your pet and confirm the price before you sign up.

items.q: How do I pay for the subscription?
items.a: Payment is made by bank transfer.

items.q: Is this suitable for both dogs and cats?
items.a: Yes, we have separate food for dogs and for cats — you pick the species in the quiz.

items.q: How do I leave a request?
items.a: Take the short quiz on the site and leave your phone number — we'll reach out on WhatsApp, Telegram, or by phone.

items.q: What if my pet has special dietary needs?
items.a: Tell us in the quiz — we'll pass it on to the operator and check the diet with a specialist if needed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This describes what data we collect during the pilot stage and how we use it. The legal entity, address, and formal legal basis are not finalized yet — this page will be completed before a public launch.
privacy.collectedBody: Your quiz answers (pet species and age, city, menu preferences, willingness to consider a subscription), and contact details: phone number, name (if provided), preferred contact method, and Telegram handle (if provided).
privacy.purposeBody: To reach out and discuss food, cost, and delivery availability in your city before the pilot launches. This is not a subscription or an order — it's a request to register interest.
privacy.operatorBody: The team behind the temporary brand "PawMeal Georgia". The legal entity and official details will be published separately before a public launch.
privacy.recipientsBody: Only the team handling requests has access. During the pilot, no third-party analytics or advertising services are connected.
privacy.securityBody: Data in transit is protected by HTTPS; access to the database and server configuration is limited to developers via server-side credentials.
privacy.retentionBody: Contact details are kept for no longer than {days} days from the request date, then deleted automatically.
privacy.marketingBody: Consent to marketing messages is separate and optional. You can withdraw it at any time using the contact below.
privacy.contactBodyConfigured: Email {email} to delete your data or ask a question.
privacy.contactBodyMissing: The operator's contact for data questions will be listed here before a public launch.
